scripts.check:css: tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o - --minify | node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; if (fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trimEnd() !== fs.readFileSync('dist/output.css', 'utf8').trimEnd()) { console.error('dist/output.css is out of date. Run npm run build:css.'); process.exit(1); }"
